rules.route: Written permission of the Island Council

others.route: Written permission of the Island Council

note: The Pitcairn Islands: anyone without a settlement visa or permanent residence needs the Island Council's written permission before taking paid employment or entering business (Immigration Control Ordinance, s. 16). No days without it. British citizens and the other territories' passports, though of the same nationality, need it too and are named; the territory's own are home.

sources.title: Visit Pitcairn (Pitcairn Islands Tourism), Visa & Legal Information
sources.said: if you have not been granted a settlement visa and are not a permanent resident of Pitcairn you need to obtain written permission from the Island Council before taking up paid employment or entering business on Pitcairn.
